node.title: PMA sigma-one B11 threshold collapse and finite-payment route cut
node.statement: On the official sigma=1 grid, maximality gives ell=2, b=1 and M=(n-k)/2. The exact B11 thresholds (E,V_2,V_R)=(0,2,0) collapse the post-periodic partition to d<=2 in J/A2 and d>=3 in GROW, with AR=RES empty. The paid certificate is J(n,k)+11 binom(M,2)q^4. At rates 1/8 and 1/16 its exact n^6 field-fit ceiling is below n+1 on every official row, so this certificate cannot provide a field-uniform finite primitive payment even though the threshold partition is closed.
